title: StagedWorkspace: A Versioned Workspace for Knowledge-Work Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.18050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly perform knowledge work (i.e., produce and modify persistent digital artifacts such as code repositories, documents, spreadsheets, slides, reports), yet the parsed views they search, the native files they edit, the changes they review, and the artifacts they submit can refer to different versions of the same work product. We formulate this as a workspace-state contract: every view should be explicitly tied to a version of the evolving workspace state. Coding agents partly address this need through repository contracts for search, diffs, and tests, whereas an analogous contract is less explicit for PDFs, spreadsheets, slides, notebooks, and mixed-format project folders. We propose StagedWorkspace, a versioned workspace for knowledge-work agents. The workspace binds parsed records and review diffs to content hashes of the native files as they change. translated_title: 阶段性工作区：面向知识工作代理的版本化工作区
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18050v1 公告类型：新 摘要：AI代理越来越多地执行知识工作（即生成和修改持久性数字工件，如代码仓库、文档、电子表格、幻灯片、报告），然而它们搜索的解析视图、编辑的原生文件、审查的更改以及提交的工件可能指向同一工作产品的不同版本。我们将此表述为工作区状态契约：每个视图都应明确关联到不断演化的工作区状态的某个版本。编码代理部分通过仓库契约（用于搜索、差异和测试）解决了这一需求，而对于PDF、电子表格、幻灯片、笔记本和混合格式项目文件夹，类似的契约则不太明确。我们提出了StagedWorkspace，一个面向知识工作代理的版本化工作区。该工作区将解析记录和审查差异绑定到原生文件变化时的内容哈希。在OfficeQA Pro和APEX-Agents上的固定框架消融实验中，双解析...
tldr: 本文提出StagedWorkspace，一个版本化工作区，通过将解析视图和审查差异绑定到原生文件的内容哈希，解决了AI代理在知识工作中因不同版本导致的视图不一致问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes StagedWorkspace, a versioned workspace that binds parsed views and review diffs to content hashes of native files, addressing version inconsistency in AI agents' knowledge work.
